Shaheed Saber
2012-03-31T00:00:00+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/news-detail-228386

Today is the 41st death anniversary of journalist and politician Shaheed Saber.

On the day in 1971, Pakistani occupation army set afire to the office of the Daily Sangbad in Bangshal which caused death to Saber, said a press release.
